tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Every asset the swap form knows, with slug, ticker, network, confirmations, extra-id name and whether it is available right now.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Every route with its own page (from/to slugs) and whether both sides are available right now.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Minimum and maximum amount for a route, in the asset you send.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Floating estimate for a route and amount: amountTo, networkFee (taken out of the payout), receiveAmount, rate. The final amount is set when the deposit confirms.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Whether an address has the right format for an asset. Does not check who owns it or whether an exchange needs a memo.

tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description: Status of one swap by id: stage (1 waiting … 5 done), deposit and payout addresses, amounts, both transaction hashes.

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Creates the swap and returns the payment instruction: the one-time deposit address, the memo if the chain needs one, the exact amount in decimal and in base units with the decimals and token contract as listed by the liquidity partner, a wallet URI where a standard exists (BIP-21, ERC-681, Solana Pa

tools.name: swap_page_link
tools.description: The page where the person completes the swap, with the amount prefilled. A swap for a person is completed by that person on the page: open the link, check the amount, both addresses and the memo on screen, then send the deposit from your own wallet. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_swap" is 667 chars, far longer than this server's median (123). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
